b.label: Carve-Out Provision (DCSA relief from NISP oversight)

edges.label: defines and operates the carve-out
edges.note: The Manual is where the carve-out is defined and where it operates. Volume 1's glossary: 'carve-out. A provision approved by the Secretary or Deputy Secretary of Defense that relieves DSS of its NISP obligation to perform industrial security oversight.' Enclosure 2 para 2 carries the operational form of the same provision, and Volume 1 also states that inspections 'will be coordinated among the SAPCOs and DSS when not carved out' - which is the sentence establishing that a carved-out SAP is not so coordinated. Quotations are the verbatim ones already recorded on this node.

b.label: DCSA as DoD Cognizant Security Office under the NISP

edges.label: relieves it of oversight
edges.note: The carve-out's effect runs against this body: the Manual's own definition is that the provision 'relieves DSS of its NISP obligation to perform industrial security oversight'. DSS is the predecessor of DCSA, which now holds the cognizant-security-office role under the NISP. The Manual is the instrument by which the oversight body is stood down for a given programme.

b.label: DoD Special Access Program Central Office (DoD SAPCO)

edges.label: assigns it the patent and inspection roles
edges.note: Volume 1 Enclosure 4 para 7: 'PATENTS AND INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. The CA SAPCO will develop procedures for processing patents and intellectual property involving SAP(s).' Volume 1 also routes inspections through the SAPCOs jointly with DSS where a programme is not carved out. Both are verbatim from this node's recorded quotations, and the patents provision is the one that matters most to this board: it is an explicit channel for intellectual property arising inside a special access programme.

b.label: DoDD 5205.07, Special Access Program (SAP) Policy (1 Jul 2010, Chg 2 of 4 Feb 2020)

edges.note: The Manual implements the Directive. The 2010 directive sets SAP policy and defines the carve-out in its glossary; the four-volume Manual carries the operating detail - Volume 1's Enclosure 2 on DSS oversight and its relief, Enclosure 4 on whistleblower routing through SAP channels, and the patents and intellectual property provision. Directive states the policy, Manual runs it.
